name: Meeting notes to action items
description: Turn raw meeting notes into decisions and owned action items.

steps.name: decisions
steps.instruction: List every decision the meeting made, one per line. Only decisions that are in the notes.

steps.name: actions
steps.instruction: From the ORIGINAL notes, list every action item as 'owner: task (due date if given)'. Use only names and dates that appear in the notes.
steps.criteria: Every owner and date must appear in the original notes; tasks without an owner go in unassigned.

steps.name: email
steps.instruction: Write a short follow-up email to the attendees with the decisions and the action items.
